I'll search for information about this Georgia Department of Revenue Motor Vehicle Division webpage.

<tool>web_search</tool>
<query>site:mvd.dor.ga.gov/tags/index.aspx Georgia vehicle registration tags</query>

<tool>web_search</tool>
<query>Georgia DOR MVD vehicle tag registration online services</query>

Based on my search, I can provide you with information about the Georgia Department of Revenue's Motor Vehicle Division (MVD) tag services.

The URL **mvd.dor.ga.gov/tags/index.aspx** appears to be a legacy or older URL for the Georgia Department of Revenue's Motor Vehicle Division online tag/vehicle registration services. 

The Georgia DOR MVD handles vehicle tag and title services including:
- Vehicle registration renewals
- Tag purchases and transfers
- Title applications
- License plate services

The current Georgia DOR MVD website has been updated and the main portal for online services is now typically accessed through **dor.georgia.gov/motor-vehicles** or related URLs. The specific "tags/index.aspx" path suggests this was an older ASP.NET page structure.

If you're trying to access Georgia vehicle tag services, I'd recommend:
- Visiting https://dor.georgia.gov/motor-vehicles for current services
- Or https://www.dor.ga.gov/ for the main Department of Revenue portal

If you have a specific question about Georgia vehicle tags or need help with a particular service, please let me know and I can search for more current information.

Sources:
1. https://dor.georgia.gov/motor-vehicles
2. https://www.dor.ga.gov/
